imageAlt: Teen girl golfer in penalty area by water accidentally plays wrong ball

issues: The only very minor issue is that the girl does not appear fully left-handed in her posture, as the club position could be interpreted as right-handed.
imageVerification.repairPrompt: Ensure the teenage girl golfer is clearly depicted with a left-handed grip and stance, so her posture and club orientation are obviously left-handed.

questions.title: What happens if you hit the wrong ball in a penalty area?
questions.question: If you hit someone else’s ball or a ball that isn’t yours from a penalty area, what happens?

choices.text: Nothing happens, just find your own ball and play it
You get 1 extra shot and hit again
You get 2 extra shots and you must play your own ball
You can’t play the rest of the hole

questions.explanation: If you play the wrong ball in a penalty area, you get 2 extra shots added to your score. Then, you must find and play your own golf ball.

vocabulary.simpleMeaning: A place on the course with water or sand marked with yellow or red lines. It can be a pond, stream, or wet ground.
A golf ball that is not yours, like another player’s ball or a practice ball.

questions.teachingTip: Remind children to always check their ball before hitting, especially in tricky places like penalty areas.
likelyMisconceptions: Children might think there is no penalty if the wrong ball is in a penalty area.
Some might think you can just keep playing with the wrong ball.

questions.title: Penalty for hitting the wrong ball in a penalty area
questions.question: If you play the wrong ball from a penalty area, what penalty do you get?

choices.text: There is no penalty, just play the correct ball
2-stroke penalty and you must play the correct ball
You are disqualified from the hole

questions.explanation: Hitting a wrong ball from a penalty area means you get a two-stroke penalty and must play the correct ball.
